design_notes: Use hairline rules to separate the financial tables; the accent colour (e.g., deep blue) for the pull-quote rule and table headers.
Set the financial table in a serif face with tabular numerals; align numbers right.
The pull-quote should sit between the concentration paragraph and the tender-cycle section, with a left rule in the accent colour.

pull_quotes.after_paragraph: The concentration is the filing's central risk. Top customers contributed 57% of revenue in FY2018, and Western Railway, a client since 2006,[^drhp-p67] accounts for 52% of the orders on hand.[^drhp-p65] The filing itself flags the risk in plain terms:
pull_quotes.quote: Majority of our revenues will be dependent on one customer, Indian Railways, which is our largest customer, contributing to 57% of our revenue in Fiscal 2018.
pull_quotes.rationale: The single most damning disclosed fact — customer concentration — is best pulled out verbatim.

sidebars.body_markdown: The offer is 44,28,000 equity shares of ₹10 each, at a price to be determined.[^drhp-p29] The lead manager is Mark Corporate Advisors Private Limited; the registrar is Bigshare Services Private Limited.[^drhp-p31] Proceeds are earmarked for working capital (₹1,130 lakhs) and general corporate purposes (amount not disclosed).[^drhp-p48] No selling shareholder is named; the draft presents the issue only as equity shares offered.[^drhp-p29] No independent appraisal or monitoring agency has been appointed; deployment of funds is at the discretion of management and the board, monitored by the audit committee.[^drhp-p18]
sidebars.rationale: A sidebar gathers the offer's key facts in one place, saving the reader from hunting through the prose.
sidebars.title: The offer at a glance

tables.after_paragraph: The financial figures in the filing are stated in ₹ lakhs. The tables below convert them to ₹ crore by dividing by 100, the unit an Indian reader expects for a company of this size.
tables.rationale: The five-year trend of falling revenue, a profit spike, and heavy short-term debt is the core financial story; a table makes the contrast scannable.
tables.title: Financial summary (₹ crore)

tables.after_paragraph: The stated use of proceeds has two heads: working capital requirements and general corporate purposes. The draft does not disclose the amount for the second.[^drhp-p48]
tables.rationale: The offer's purpose is a key decision input; a compact table shows the disclosed amount and the gap.
tables.title: Use of proceeds
